title: PixelOver
description:
Pixel art animation softwarePixelOver is a pixel art oriented animation tool designed to turn your artwork into clean, pixel-perfect renders. Use real-time effects like dithering and indexation, then animate with keyframes and bones while keeping clean results thanks to pixel-art resampling.Main features• Import images, GIFs, and 3D models

• Layer-based workflow with pixel-art effects: indexation, dithering, pixel-perfect lines, color cycling, and more

• Parent-child transform system for building clean hierarchies

• Real-time animation with keyframes and bone rigging

• Inverse kinematics (IK) for faster posing and character animation

• Mesh deformation for flexible 2D animation and advanced rigs

• Export to images, GIFs, or spritesheets
description_short: PixelOver is a pixel art animation tool that transforms your artwork into pixel-perfect renders. Animate in real time with keyframes, bones, inverse kinematics, and pixel-accurate transforms for pixel perfect sprites, GIFs, and spritesheets.
